connector.name: MCP by scorecard.io
connector.registryDescription: MCP server providing access to the Scorecard API to evaluate and optimize LLM systems.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.scorecard.io over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package scorecard-ai-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace io.scorecard. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SCORECARD_API_KEY
env.description: Scorecard API key for authentication. Get your API key from https://app.scorecard.io/settings
